selection: Common-sample histogram MI of moved PET and CT; no ground truth used for candidate selection
affine: unconstrained local refinement; no guarantee of anatomical plausibility
relative: Ts @ inverse(T0), each method own T0
runtime: Affine total includes multi-start; existing times from saved runs
roi: Analytic centroid and volume ratio; CNR common voxels per test, not across all tests; no clinical TRE or SUV
